description: This PHP source file defines the ModulesLib class within the SuiteCRM API v8 Library namespace. It provides methods for generating paginated module records, handling pagination links, sorting, filtering, and retrieving the current user, specifically for managing module data in SuiteCRM.

classes.name: ModulesLib
classes.description: A class providing methods for managing module data, including pagination, filtering, sorting, and user retrieval within the SuiteCRM API v8 context.

methods.name: generatePaginatedModuleRecords
methods.description: Generates a paginated list of module records, including resource conversion and link generation.

methods.name: generatePaginatedLinksFromModuleRecords
methods.description: Creates pagination links for module record listings based on current pagination state.

methods.name: getSorting
methods.description: Processes request parameters to generate SQL ORDER BY clause.

methods.name: getModuleList
methods.description: Retrieves a list of module records applying filters, sorting, and pagination.

methods.name: generatePaginationUrl
methods.description: Constructs URLs for pagination links with appropriate query parameters.

methods.name: getCurrentUser
methods.description: Retrieves the current user based on OAuth user ID from the request.
